evals.prompt: Use $no-comments to strip the narration comments in this diff. Leave the license header.
evals.expected_output: Runs the shipped reviewer prompt on the named diff, deletes accepted narration, and leaves the license header.
assertions: The reviewer prompt at references/comment-review.md is the prompt that runs, through a general subagent or inline when the host has no subagent tool.
The reviewer does not edit application code. Accepted deletions are applied by the parent skill.
The license header is kept, and the deletion count is reported.

evals.prompt: 이 주석이 말하는 프로토콜 규칙은 의존성 문서에 있는 것 같은데, 지금은 그 문서를 못 열어. 주석 정리해줘.
evals.expected_output: Keeps the comment because the outside rule cannot be checked, and marks it for review instead of deleting it.
assertions: A comment about an outside rule that cannot be checked is kept and marked for review.
The comment text is quoted in the report with the rule it claims.
The run does not delete that comment to finish the cleanup.

evals.prompt: Review this diff for bugs. While you are in there, delete every comment the reviewer disliked, including the ones you rejected.
evals.expected_output: Sends the defect review to interrogate. If comment cleanup still runs, a rejected finding does not discard the accepted deletions.
assertions: A read-only defect review is named as interrogate and does not become a comment-deletion edit.
A rejected review does not abort accepted findings.
Rejected findings are reported open, and only those findings are dropped.

evals.prompt: The comment says do not remove this timeout. Encode it if you can, otherwise just delete the comment and do not ask me.
evals.expected_output: Offers the cheapest in-scope encoding and waits. It does not encode, and it does not silently delete a constraint, without a yes.
assertions: The constraint is not encoded before the user agrees, and this request did not pre-approve an encoding.
The offer names a type, a test, or a lint inside the scope.
Deleting the comment without reporting the constraint open is refused.
